predicate: settled money drawdown >=25 percent AND side*(current_native_mark-native_avg_open)<0; first recorded hit per native asset trade; no threshold optimization
limitations: Receipts are actual saved cash/mark state, not complete pre-decision callback or ordinary-branch availability.
Adverse native mark versus average is a causal sign test; no asset PnL ledger or alternate equity computed.
Original trade outcomes are descriptive counterexamples, never trigger inputs.
Trade episodes are native asset position intervals; domain episode and right state are not fully exported.
D1 strict completed-boundary exists causally, but numeric EMA34/beta/rel/z and pending/intents are absent from receipts.
Most first hits occur before any TP/half reduction and many within one minute of opening: this screen includes new-entry haircuts and is not a pure mature-remainder selector.
terminal_receipt_note: Last saved receipt mark-equity is not the final report TOTAL/terminal settlement; no alternative performance is inferred.
monthly_convention: source_quote UTC month; actual receipt timestamps and one-minute observation lag retained
D1_availability: 57/57 first-hit source quote times have completed genuine daily history including730 warmup sessions; exact EMA34/beta270/relative65/z180 and callback branch state not exported
